title: Inductive Correlation Clustering with Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.27153v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Correlation Clustering (CC) is a natural formulation of clustering in combinatorial optimization, which uses a graph representation of the input and does not require a pre-specified number of clusters. Given $n$ objects and a pairwise similarity function, the goal is to cluster the objects so that similar objects are put in the same cluster and dissimilar objects are put in different clusters. Despite its versatility, existing CC algorithms suffer from significant scalability issues and are inherently transductive: i.e., the algorithm must be executed from scratch for any new problem instance.   In this work, we bridge this gap by leveraging Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to solve Inductive Correlation Clustering, a novel generalization of the CC problem designed to handle unseen graph instances. By learning to exploit common structural patterns and node features during training, our framework generalizes to new graphs drawn from the same

translated_title: 基于图神经网络的归纳式相关聚类
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27153v1 公告类型：新 摘要：相关聚类（CC）是组合优化中一种自然的聚类形式，它使用输入的图表示，且不需要预先指定聚类数量。给定$n$个对象和成对相似性函数，目标是聚类这些对象，使得相似对象被归入同一聚类，不相似对象被归入不同聚类。尽管其具有多功能性，现有CC算法存在显著的可扩展性问题，并且本质上是转导性的：即，对于任何新的问题实例，算法必须从头执行。在这项工作中，我们通过利用图神经网络（GNN）来弥合这一差距，解决归纳式相关聚类问题，这是CC问题的一种新颖泛化，旨在处理未见过的图实例。通过在训练过程中学习利用常见的结构模式和节点特征，我们的框架能够泛化到从同一分布中抽取的新图。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图神经网络的归纳式相关聚类方法，首次将CC问题推广到处理未见过的图实例，通过学习结构模式和节点特征实现对新图的泛化，解决了现有算法的可扩展性和转导性限制。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an inductive correlation clustering method using graph neural networks, generalizing CC to unseen graph instances by learning structural patterns and node features, overcoming scalability and transductive limitations of existing algorithms.
